_doc: Filter and category rules for `legoscout triage`. DATA, not code: triage.py is the engine that loads this once, applies the filter, and tags the first matching category. Lifted verbatim from the three retired root scripts (categorize.py, filter_items.py, process_candidates.py).

categories.name: set
categories._doc: Checked FIRST: a four- or five-digit run in the title is a set number, and that beats the bulk keywords a set listing may also carry.

categories.name: minifigure
categories._doc: A single minifigure or a lot of minifigures. The classifier re-tags every candidate authoritatively; this is the crawl-side pre-filter tag.
